forbiddenAnatomy: Invented tissue or patient response data

checks: Two distinct paths: stopwatch/short path and calendar/longer path.
No lung or airway anatomy, no plotted patient response curve.
No claim inhaled corticosteroid cures asthma or supplies immediate rescue.
No dosing instructions and no assertion all regimens separate reliever from controller; schematic names the two specific medicine classes.
validation.pixelReviewNotes: Full pixel-to-specification review: the salbutamol lane connects a minutes stopwatch to a relaxed mechanical spring; the corticosteroid lane uses repeated calendar checks and a shield beside fading inflammation symbols. Clear named medicines prevent reliance on device colour. No airway, lung or tissue appears, no doses are given, and the prescribed-plan qualifier is present.
